issue.title: Evidence: machine stdout/stderr failure conformance round (E-9 modes + E-8 sites, #290)
issue.body:
Evidence PR for #290 (MACHINE-STDOUT-FAILURE-CONFORMANCE-1). Base 6a9b051 (post-#292). PRODUCTION_BEHAVIOR_CHANGE=NONE / D11_CHANGE=NONE / K0_CHANGE=NONE / ABI_CHANGE=NONE / ADR_CHANGE=NONE.

## Commits

- C1 9386592 — frozen source map + BDD scenarios (implementation-record §14.1–§14.7): SOURCE_DAG, CATCH_BOUNDARY_MAP, HOST_FAILURE_ORDER_MAP, REPORT_SITE_INVENTORY (re-verified at HEAD), FEATURE_PLATFORM_MATRIX, B1–B6 with oracles/negative controls, class ladder + RQ1–RQ6 + probe designs, pre-declared NOT_RUN register.
- C2/C3 d9d179c — the probes: E-9 reader stdout/stderr print-panic + blocked-park subprocess choreography over REAL pipes; E-8 sites #1 (real production binary) / #4 / #6 / #7 (test-transport children with runtime disposal witnesses). POSIX-pipe lane is `#[cfg(unix)]`; the Windows broken-sink lane stays NOT_RUN per the frozen matrix.
- C4 5c05998 — §14.8 results.
- C5 8c68a7f — decision-record §7: the D-D decision package (not a ruling).
- Review rounds: 8cdc2d2 (R1–R3 fixes), 28542a2 (R4–R6 fixes); owner P1 probe repair: 6abdf12 + 1c62399 (v2 committed flush probe, 2 delta reviewers APPROVE), 38e214b (CI receipts). B2 round: 6bfd9f3 (owner D-D ratification record), dff9d76 (child-aware watchdog), 18e823c (premise canary + spawn-window lock), d7d9f2e (records) — root cause named (fork->exec forkling window), owner-directed sufficiency review (3 fresh-context reviewers, APPROVE_WITH_NITS) with all findings fixed, see the B2 round comment.

## Headline results

- B1/B2 (reader print panic, stdout/stderr arms): EVIDENCED on real pipes — panic caught, `HostFailure::Panic` recorded first, conditional Stop routed, seal `Some(Panic)`, host-failure report distinct from the D11 `Stopped` terminal; the outcome row then panics on MAIN against the same broken sink (ledger #6: later reports only) — recorded verbatim.
- B3 (flush-Err at machine_input.rs:274): classified **INJECTED_WRITER_ONLY** — no independent flush-Err window exists in the production shape (PA/PA-2/PB/interleave/file/EBADF std-only probes; probe source inlined in §14.8.3). Option A's gate is unmet.
- B4 (blocked): EVIDENCED with the round's own premise corrected — the transport's seal closes stdin admission right after the stop settles, so a post-stop flood is cut off; the park is real and constructed by pre-filling the sink (self-verifying against capacity drift). Blocking is not a failure.
- B5: the five cited seal-boundary oracles re-run green.
- B6/E-8: per-site matrix; #4/#7 disposal-skip RUNTIME-WITNESSED; site attribution rides healthy-sink controls + per-site witnesses (print! panics inside std, never at the call site).
- Windows: healthy-sink real-Windows rows (x86_64-pc-windows-gnu via interop); broken-sink Windows = NOT_RUN, registered §14.7.

## Review

Six independent fresh-context reviews (R1 source fidelity, R2 oracle adequacy, R3 E-8 attribution, R4 cross-platform truth, R5 authority boundary, R6 evidence integrity). R1/R3/R4/R6 initially REJECT, R2/R5 APPROVE — every P1/P2 fixed (8cdc2d2, 28542a2); all lanes green after each fix round; the delta-review P2s fixed in 1c62399.

## Evidence integrity disclosures

- The first `git push` attempt's gate log was piped through `tail` and lost (EVIDENCE_LOST; comment below). Attempt 2+ ran the complete gate with full logs archived.
- The session-local evidence archive `/tmp/q290` was destroyed after execution (EVIDENCE_ARCHIVE_LOST, §14.8.8): surviving evidence is the committed oracles, the inlined probe source, GitHub-held CI logs, and explicitly-marked transcription-only values (Windows interop rows, probe outputs, two toolchain observations).

## Verification

- Local pre-push gate `--all-files`: green at every pushed tip (archived; the previously disclosed load-sensitive first-occurrence red at a B2 test was classified this round — forkling root cause — fixed by the canary + spawn-window lock layers, and re-verified under saturation; reds from intermediate gate rounds are archived, see the B2 round comment).
- `cargo test --workspace` green; machine_input 45/45 solo and 20/20 under saturation post-fix; fmt + clippy `-D warnings` clean.
- PR CI: Linux + windows-latest lanes PASS at 8c68a7f and 8cdc2d2 (windows lane runs the suite with the pipe choreography cfg(unix)-excluded by declaration).

## What is NOT decided here

D-D (the `:274` flush-Err disposition) was RATIFIED by the owner as OPTION_B_SCOPED (decision-record §7.0, committed 6bfd9f3; scope = current writer/format/std/environments only; T1–T4 revisit triggers preserved). Merge of this PR and issue #290 closure remain owner decisions; #290 closure must keep the native-Windows broken-sink and terminal-sink lanes explicitly NOT_RUN — Windows compile PASS is not a substitute. This PR stays OPEN; no merge.

Evidence-chain disclosure (Failure Evidence Contract): the FIRST `git push` attempt's pre-push gate output was piped through `tail` and its full log was not archived (visible remainder: `rust-test 🥊 48.57s` then `error: failed to push some refs`). That log is EVIDENCE_LOST for the attempt-1 gate run; it is not claimed as a pass. Attempt 2 re-ran the complete `--all-files` gate and its full log is archived (/tmp/q290/push2.log, 188.47s, all 8 checks green) — the pushed tip is that green run's tip. Root cause of the loss is process error (piping gate output), corrected for every subsequent run.

Independent review round complete — six fresh-context reviewers (per the campaign's review policy), run in two waves:

**Wave 1 (on 8c68a7f):** R1 source fidelity — REJECT (4 P1: version/help anchors, a stale ledger-#3 note in §14.4, site-#5 gate cell "always" vs the module gate, a :91/:86 seal anchor) · R2 oracle adequacy — APPROVE (7 P2, incl. two unasserted recorded values and the probe source not committed) · R3 E-8 attribution — REJECT (1 P1: the arg-error OBSERVED cell claimed a panic text that is structurally unobservable; 5 P2).

**Wave 2 (on 8cdc2d2):** R4 cross-platform truth — REJECT (1 P1: the surviving-evidence claim overreached for the Windows interop rows, which have no committed oracle) · R5 authority boundary — APPROVE (5 P2, incl. PROPERTY/AUTHORITY label blur on a not-yet-ratified D-D) · R6 evidence integrity — REJECT (2 P1: three values — F_GETPIPE_SZ, stdio.rs:1166, probe outputs — not backed by any surviving committed instrument; frozen-section edits without an in-record amendment declaration).

**All P1/P2 fixed** in 8cdc2d2 and 28542a2; local gate + both CI lanes green after each round. The F_GETPIPE_SZ capacity measurement is now recorded as a lost-log observation with the blocked construction documented as self-verifying (any capacity drift → the child exits early → the parked-window poll fails loudly, never a false pass).

One further disclosure since wave 1: the session-local evidence archive (/tmp/q290) was destroyed from outside the session after execution — EVIDENCE_ARCHIVE_LOST, handled in §14.8.8 with the surviving-evidence enumeration scoped per claim (committed oracles / inlined probe source / GitHub CI logs / transcription-only survivors).

Nothing here ratifies D-D; decision-record §7 remains OWNER_RULING_PENDING for the owner.

## P1 修复交付 — v2 flush 探针（已提交测试 + CI 收据）

P1 成立。核对 v1 内联源码确认了两处缺陷：PA/interleave 臂在 `print!` 与被观察 `flush()` 之间确有显式 `let _ = io::stdout().flush();`，且 PA-2 是独立进程的 sink——两者叠加使 `FLUSH=Ok(())` 失去区分力。已按 7 项修复要求完成最小修复（`6abdf12` test + `1c62399` 评审措辞 + `38e214b` CI 收据；两个 fresh-context 评审 APPROVE，P2/NOTE 全部清零）。无产品代码改动：PRODUCTION_BEHAVIOR_CHANGE=NONE 维持。

### 逐项落实

| # | 要求 | 落实 |
|---|------|------|
| 1 | 删除中间 flush | PA/interleave 臂内现在只有一个 flush 调用（目标 flush）；witness 全走 stderr |
| 2 | 父进程实测读到完整 newline row 再关 pipe | `read_row_then_close`：读满含 `\n` 的 needle → 读端**在线程内 drop（关闭）先于回报** → 父进程收到后才写 `go`。行未到 pipe ⇒ kill + `BLOCKED/PREMISE REFUTED` panic——前提是被同步观察的，被推翻即红，绝不为绿 |
| 3 | 关闭后唯一目标 flush 并记录 | gate 释放后 `flush()` → `Q290-PA FLUSH={r:?}` 记录在健康 stderr |
| 4 | PA-2 同一已关闭 sink 二次 `print!` | 同一子进程、同一 `io::stdout()`：Ok 之后第二次 `print!` 必须 panic（"failed printing to stdout" + "Broken pipe" + `PRINT_PANIC=true` 三重断言）⇒ 证明 flush 返回 Ok 时 sink 已坏 ⇒ Ok 只能意味着「未发生写」。您的第 2 项担忧也被做成可观察前提：若删掉中间 flush 后行到不了 pipe，PA 直接红（premise refuted） |
| 5 | PB 无换行尾部对照 | 保留：尾部滞留缓冲（若已到 fd，唯一 flush 会得 Ok）⇒ 唯一 flush 必 `Err(BrokenPipe)` |
| 6 | RQ5 interleave | v1 interleave 确有同样缺陷，已撤销；v2 中 tail+row 在任何 flush 之前被父进程观察到（tail 先于 row）⇒ 尾部由下一行的 `print!` 带出，trailing flush 得 Ok（同一 proven-broken sink） |
| 7 | 可重复工件 + 收据 | 探针固化为已提交 `#[cfg(unix)]` 测试（`e9_flush_probe_*`，与套件既有 child 模式一致）。CI 实跑收据：**1c62399 Linux lane run 39046043339，4/4 全绿**（已在 run 日志中核对测试行）；windows-latest run 39046043276 PASS（cfg(unix) 按声明排除）。本地日志归档 `290-r2-flushprobe/`（首跑 4/4、module 45/45、两个突变日志、三轮完整 gate 日志） |

### Oracle 咬合验证（突变）

- PB 尾部加 `\n` ⇒ PB 红（flush 得 Ok，Err-marker 等待超时）。
- PA 删第二次 `print!` ⇒ PA 红（brokenness 见证缺失）。

### v1 处置（§14.8.3 已声明，不静默覆盖）

PA / interleave 的 Ok **WITHDRAWN**（非区分性）；PB Err、PA-2 panic 观察、EBADF 吞噬结论成立（不依赖被混淆步骤，逐条注明理由；file-sink 格降为仅佐证）。决策记录 §7.2 已改述为 v2 同 sink 证据链；§7.4 T3 增注：已提交的 PA 测试即 std 缓冲回归的自动 tripwire（premise / flush-value / brokenness 三 oracle 之一会红）。**D-D 保持 OWNER_RULING_PENDING，未代行裁决。**

### 披露：一次 gate 红（既有 B2 测试，非本 delta 引入）

全量 `--all-files` gate 首跑中 `e9_real_reader_stderr_epipe_follows_the_documented_host_failure_classes`（本轮早前新增）在 30s 内未等到 `Q290-E9-UNWIND`（全工作区并行高压下首次出现；失败树与 24 分钟前全绿树仅差注释行）。单测重跑 0.04s 绿，全量 gate 重跑 8/8 绿（167.59s）。红档未洗：完整日志 + SHA + rc + 签名 sidecar 归档（`gate-p1-repair-final.log` + `FAILURE-SIDECAR.txt` + solo/full 重跑日志）。**该测试的界与编排未被改动**——是否放宽 bound 或调整并行行为属测试编排问题，留给 owner 判断。

### 状态

```
D_D_OWNER_RULING = PENDING（您的 HOLD_PENDING_EVIDENCE_REPAIR 所要求的修复已交付）
ISSUE_290        = OPEN
PR_293           = OPEN（不自行合并；等待 RATIFY_OPTION_B_SCOPED 或进一步指示）
```

## B2 round: root cause named, fix layers landed, sufficiency review passed

**Range:** `6bfd9f3` (owner D-D ratification record) → `dff9d76` (child-aware watchdog) → `18e823c` (premise canary + spawn-window lock) → `d7d9f2e` (records). All pushed to this branch; local final tree `49ea566`, full local gate green (`lefthook run pre-push --all-files`, 8/8).

### Classification outcome (owner's 5-step directive)
- **Bound unchanged.** The 30s marker watchdog is byte-identical; this round classifies, it does not re-promise.
- **Root cause named** with a standalone reproducer (zero qianqian code): a fork→exec **forkling window** — a concurrently spawned child briefly holds the whole parent fd table, including OTHER tests' pipe read ends (O_CLOEXEC not yet applied) — makes a parent-side `close(2)` silently ineffective. The "broken sink" premise never breaks: PA-2's second `print!` succeeded, PB's flush returned `Ok`, site6/site7 transports completed on unbroken sinks (`UNWIND=0`); the epipe arms wedged at `wait_terminal` (no panic → no Stop → a test source that never self-completes; all child threads STATIC in futex).
- **A/B evidence:** 46/100 anomalous with parallel spawns under 20-busy-loop CPU saturation vs 0/60 sequential; foreign read-end holders named by `/proc` fdinfo walks (`mode=R`, O_CLOEXEC set, neither victim parent nor child).
- Event observations sit at existing semantic boundaries (GATE-READY gate, RUN-RETURNED / TERMINAL / UNWIND witnesses, byte-arrival timeline, /proc two-sample thread states); no sleep-as-synchronization was added.

### Fix layers (test orchestration only — PRODUCTION_BEHAVIOR_CHANGE=NONE)
- **(a) premise canary:** post-close `require_broken_sink`; an unbroken sink is a deterministic `Q290-PREMISE-REFUTED` red (child exit 3, watchdog-classified), never a silent anomaly. The canary's default-hook panic text is silenced (momentary hook swap) so it cannot pre-satisfy the choreography's own "failed printing to stdout" assertions.
- **(b) spawn-window lock:** process-wide, poison-tolerant `test_spawn_lock`; every close-dependent spawn (including the site1 arms and the shutdown_tests witnesses) is lock-covered.
- **(c) watchdog:** DIED (incl. PREMISE-REFUTED) vs BLOCKED classification + forensics; late-arrival recheck in the DIED branch; gdb capture deadline-bounded (10s).

### Negative controls + verification
- NC-A (silent death → DIED), NC-B (deterministic hang → BLOCKED), NC-C (close skipped → PREMISE-REFUTED exit 3; re-run RED after the review fixes).
- Solo module 45/45; saturated module 20/20 (pre-fix 8/10 red; canary-only batch: all 16 reds deterministic PREMISE-REFUTED — the class is never silent); full-lib 3/3; post-review saturated 3/3; Windows **compile** cross-check `cargo check --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu --all-targets` green (compile-only, not runtime).
- Gate history preserved, reds diagnosed not washed: round1 rc=1 (commit-convention, header reworded), round4 rc=1 (clippy unused-import introduced by the gdb rewrite — diagnosed and fixed), round5 rc=0.

### Owner-directed sufficiency review (独立复核)
Three fresh-context reviewers; verdicts all **APPROVE_WITH_NITS**; the number-vs-log audit found every claimed figure (45/45, 20/20, 8/10, 3/3, 46/100 vs 0/60, NC-C, gate) MATCHED its archived log. All findings fixed in this push:
- uncovered spawn in the site1 version arm → lock-covered;
- lock poisoning could cascade one watchdog red into spurious `PoisonError` reds → poison-tolerant lock;
- unbounded failure-path gdb wait → deadline + kill;
- canary message taint of three sub-checks → silenced at the source;
- plus DIED late-arrival reclassification, GATE-READY wording precision in the records, retroactive batch receipts, and a provenance addendum for the archive (the `59/100` line in ROOT-CAUSE.txt has no retained log; the docs claim only 46/100).

### Status
B2's causal gap is solved and independently reviewed — the merge decision on #293 remains the owner's. #290 closure must keep the native-Windows broken-sink and terminal-sink lanes explicitly NOT_RUN; Windows compile PASS is not a substitute (owner: “不能把它们悄悄计入 PASS”).

CI receipts for `d7d9f2e` (all green): Linux fmt/check/test/clippy — [run 39059289846](https://github.com/jnhu76/qianqian/actions/runs/39059289846) (3m43s); cfg(windows) compile + device-free tests — [run 39059289844](https://github.com/jnhu76/qianqian/actions/runs/39059289844) (5m29s); topology allowlist + export surface + negative controls — [run 39059289853](https://github.com/jnhu76/qianqian/actions/runs/39059289853) (41s). The Windows lane is compile + device-free only; the native-Windows broken-sink lane remains NOT_RUN (runtime), to be covered with #288.
